headlines.title: China Drives Biggest Stock Gain Since 2024 With Rare Midday Vow
headlines.summary: When Beijing drops a rare midday market-support statement, you put down your coffee and pay attention — this is the kind of tape-moving intervention that ripples from Shanghai to the S&P. China-exposed names, emerging market ETFs, and commodity plays like copper all feel this one immediately. The timing, right as U.S. futures are rallying post-Thanksgiving, amplifies the risk-on signal across every asset class.

headlines.title: Attack on Saudi Aramco's Jazan refinery kills worker, halts some operations
headlines.summary: A direct hit on Saudi Aramco infrastructure is the kind of headline that gets oil traders off their bar stools on a holiday weekend — supply disruption risk at the world's biggest crude exporter is never background noise. Pair this with the OPEC+ quota meeting Sunday and Iranian drone activity in Kuwait, and you've got a genuine geopolitical bid under crude. Energy sector and defense names will feel this on the open.

headlines.title: Stocks are poised for a Friday jump — right into a $100 billion wave of automated selling, Goldman Sachs warns
headlines.summary: Goldman's desk flagging $100 billion in systematic selling pressure into a holiday-thin tape is the kind of flow warning that makes every buy-the-dip cowboy think twice. CTA and vol-control funds don't care about your fundamental thesis — they sell when the model says sell, and a light-volume Black Friday session is exactly when that kind of forced flow can punch above its weight. Watch the intraday action closely; the open gap could get faded hard.
